tiktok.caption: Your brain values $50 today the same as $100 next year. Scientists measured it. That one glitch has a $122,000 price tag.

youtube_short.title: Your Brain Is Hardwired to Stay Broke
title_alternatives: The $122K Reason You Can't Save Money
Why $50 Now Feels Better Than $100 Later
youtube_short.description: There's a real scientific name for why you pick the smaller reward right now: hyperbolic discounting. Studies show your brain can devalue future money by up to 7x compared to money in your hand today. That's why payday loans charging 391% APR still have lines out the door — people literally pay hundreds extra just to have cash today instead of Friday. And every time you skip a savings deposit to spend on something right now, the same wiring kicks in. Only 29% of Americans have a 3-month emergency fund. Spending an extra $100/month instead of investing it costs you $122,000 at retirement. The fix isn't willpower — it's automation. Set up auto-transfer before the money hits your account and your brain never gets a vote. Follow for daily money psychology drops. #finance #money #personalfinance #investing #moneypsychology

hook_line: Your brain values $50 now over $100 next year
